claim: Advanced multi-agent operators receive unusually high benefit from preserving decision context across handoffs
scope: The bundled fictional multi-workspace AI corpus
observable_predictions: Operators ahead on multi-workspace coordination sustain explicit handoff artifacts when reconstruction cost is high.
The artifact produces net benefit only when its upkeep remains below avoided reconstruction cost.
strongest_plausible_refuter: Independent advanced operators consistently abandon low-maintenance handoff practices because avoided reconstruction never exceeds upkeep.
rival_explanations: The maintained artifact reflects personal documentation preference rather than unusually high handoff benefit.
Reported savings reflect fictional self-estimation rather than a reliable outcome.
targeted_refutation_searches: Inspect the independent abandonment case and any operators exposed to multi-workspace coordination without sustained handoff artifacts.

contrastive_cases.interpretation: The qualified fictional episode sustained a handoff artifact and reports lower reconstruction effort.
The independent fictional counterexample abandoned a ledger when upkeep exceeded estimated savings.

boundary_conditions: Any benefit claim is bounded to the synthetic fixture.
Upkeep must remain below avoided reconstruction cost.
update_rationale: The positive episode survives within the fixture, while the independent abandonment case narrows the claim to low-maintenance mechanisms and prevents generalization.
